title: 5 Lessons I learned from talking with Multi-Millionaires

chapters.title: Stepping Out of Your Comfort Zone
Let Your Money Work For You

transcript_chunks.text: i have interviewed over a thousand multi-millionaires and today i'm gonna be giving you the top five lessons i've learned over this time so without further ado let's jump right into it starting with number one taking risks i

can't stress enough the amount of times that i've talked to a multi-millionaire and they've emphasized this over and over and over again the importance of not being afraid to take risks while you're young the reason why this is so

critical is because it's very common that a lot of people get very afraid of failing and therefore they want to play it very safe and not take risks however it's very important and you hear this all the time from very successful people

that the only way to make it to that top one percent to really make it to the top of that industry is to take risk to get out of your comfort zone and do things that not a lot of people would do you're gonna fail that's a part of life you're

gonna fail when you take chances when you take risks you're gonna be a fail but it's all about responding to that failure in a positive way getting back up on your feet learning from your mistakes and keeping going you can't be

afraid to step out of your comfort zone when you get into that area of uncomfortability that's when you're forced to really grow to develop new skills to adapt lifestyle changes to learn the ins and outs of different things getting out of your comfort zone

is something that we had to do and ultimately led to us meeting a ton of multi-millionaires and there's going to be more on that later throughout this video of how we were able to do that so stay tuned the next biggest lesson that we learned from

talking to multi-millionaires is to follow your passion and align that with what can be monetized in other words whatever your heart's desire is whatever brings you that burning passion whatever your biggest desires are whether it's

music whether it's coding whether it's sports whatever that may be follow your passion go all in with it and find ways to monetize it whether it's through content whether it's through selling a service selling a product aligned with your passion

whatever it may be you're going to be so much more successful if you're doing something that you love and you really care about and you're putting all of your time and effort into that as opposed to something that you don't care

about if you're stressing and you're putting all of your effort into something that you don't care about just for you know short-term gains or for you know for something that might look like a lot of money at the time it's not

worth it you need to follow what keeps you up at night you need to follow that thing that you have a desire and a love for and go all in with that and you will think yourself so much more in the future because of the things that you're

able to do with it the third lesson that we have today that you hear all the time over and over again that we've had stress to us from multi-millionaire entrepreneurs specifically is to start sooner we're all susceptible to coming

up with all these great ideas and saying that yeah i'm going to build this business or i'm going to start this podcast or i'm going to build this store and how many times do we end up not doing that it's very often that because we set

these deadlines or we say that oh i'm going to do this this next month and then it turns into six months and then it turns into a year and it just never happens when you have that idea go start now start sooner and don't wait

for anyone else this kind of goes toe and toe with the last one but when you have that burning passion for something and you want to monetize that start now find ways to make money with that skill or with that passion but starting sooner

is critical and often one of the biggest regrets of many business owners and entrepreneurs is that they didn't start sooner the fourth lesson i have for you today is to build your network it is so critical and we hear this over and over

again from talking to multi-millionaires the importance of building your network surrounding yourself by like-minded people and it's even more important when you're starting out in a specific industry or a specific career to align yourself

with people in other words mentors who've been there who've done what you want to do who've scaled their business who've sold their records whatever it may be who've been to that point that you desire to get to surround yourself with those

people learn everything you can from them and become best friends with them oftentimes when you're pursuing a journey such as entrepreneurship it can become very lonely and therefore it's very important to have a strong support

system with you those who are supporting all of your goals and all of your dreams those who have similar ambitions and similar desires to you to achieve success whether that may be starting and growing a business obtaining financial freedom growing on

that social media platform dropping that next album whatever that may be you need to be around people who are going to support you who are going to encourage you who are going to constructively criticize you and help you get to that

next level of what you want to get to connecting this a little bit to an earlier point that i brought up earlier about getting out of your comfort zone one of the things that we were able to do with our platform was we were able to

reach out to multi-millionaires of business owners let them know about the platform that we had and essentially you know even if it's 10 or 15 minutes if it's lunch whatever it may be the thing is is that if you stress that

you have a desire to achieve something people are going to be willing to help out don't be afraid to reach out to people you never know where that connection could take you even if it's for 10 or 15 minutes there's so much

value that you can get from certain people so be wise about who you're hanging out with and be diligent as far as obtaining the connections that you need to succeed in your field one last thing to note here is that it's important to keep your eyes open

throughout your local community or your city to see if there are any networking events or conventions going on throughout your area whether it's for entrepreneurs or startups or sports or music whatever that may be if it's

something that you want to align yourself with go to those events connect with people get the contacts pursue those relationships and develop them and grow the final lesson that i have for you guys today is to let your money work

for you it is so common that you hear from multi-millionaires what led them to the point that they are today is because they didn't let their just money sit in the bank or they didn't spend all their money they were wise with that money in

the sense that they took the money that they earned from their careers from their businesses whether they were corporate whether they went the entrepreneur route it's very common that you hear from a lot of these people that

they took the money that they had and they put it into tangible assets such as real estate or they invested in stocks nowadays a lot of people are investing in cryptocurrency they're allowing their money to grow when you let your money

sit in the bank over time with inflation that money is going down in value it's not gaining value but if you're putting that money in assets like real estate and markets where it's appreciating that's ultimately how your money is

going to work for you and you're going to thank yourself so much more in the future when you put that money in assets where your money can grow with that being said those are the five lessons that i have learned from multi-millionaires over the course of

the last year if you enjoyed this video and you learned something new be sure to leave us a like and subscribe we've got tons of new content coming over the next few months be sure to check out this video on five ways to make a thousand
